This opportunity led me to develop Portfolio.motich.com, a full-stack web application that serves as both a professional digital portfolio and a practical demonstration of my development skills.

The platform allows me to present my work, manage professional information, showcase projects, and demonstrate experience with technologies such as React, Node.js, Express, and Microsoft SQL Server.

Secondary beneficiaries include potential clients looking for technical services, professional collaborators interested in partnerships, and academic institutions evaluating my achievements.
